name: Lantern of Revealing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Its light shows Invisible creatures and objects within 30 ft.
text: Anything Invisible, creature or object, becomes visible while it is inside this hooded lantern's Bright Light. Lit, it burns for 6 hours per 1 pint of oil and gives off Bright Light out to 30 feet and Dim Light for 30 feet past that. Lowering the hood, a Magic action, shrinks the glow to Dim Light within 5 feet.
